A '''grounger''' was a porcine creature found on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] jumped onto a grounger's back and wrestled it onto the ground before binding its feet with a lasso, in order to demonstrate to the younger [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] how to capture a grounger.<ref name="Ewoks A Warrior and a Lurdo">{{Ewoks|A Warrior and a Lurdo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A grounger appeared in the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] episode "[[A Warrior and a Lurdo]],"<ref name="Ewoks A Warrior and a Lurdo" /> which was originally broadcast on [[October 25]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
